def factor_book_yield_leverage_roa(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    book_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["pb_lf"].replace(0, np.nan)
    debt_ratio = df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0
    adj = (1 - debt_ratio).clip(lower=0.1, upper=1.0)
    roa = df_copy["roa2_ttm2"] / 100.0
    roa_conf = (1 + roa).clip(lower=0.5, upper=2.0)
    result = book_yield * adj * roa_conf
    result.name = "factor_book_yield_leverage_roa"
    return result
